what: research-harness-dispatch results carry verdict=no_action_warranted on ANY successful run (harness_dispatch_result.py: 'E7 wiring-proof dispatch: this run's only claim is that the harness ran'), so a unit's own pre-registered rule is never applied by the pipeline. 2026-10-04: RQ-20260929-106 (SPY/QQQ pairs 1h) landed measured/no_action_warranted with net_total_r -121.96R over n=178 (its rule: FAIL if net_total_r<=0 with n>=39); RQ-20260929-105 landed no_action_warranted with +18.72R n=144 (rule: PASS); RQ-20260929-107 landed n=10 (rule: indeterminate). Anyone reading the verdict field alone reads all three as the same. Sessions applied the rules by hand for those three; the mapper should apply a unit's declared decision_rule thresholds (net_total_r>0 and n>=floor) or stamp the verdict not_applicable/wiring_only so it cannot read as a result.
